instruction: A candid full-shot photograph shows an indoor motion capture studio with a red carpet and white walls. On the left, the man in the black polo shirt and blue shorts (R1) stands facing right, watching the woman. In the center-right, the woman in the white patterned t-shirt (R2) stands with her back to the camera, balancing on her right leg while kicking her left leg out toward the man. Overhead studio lights illuminate the room, casting soft shadows on the floor. The camera captures the action from a wide angle.
elements: R2 is the one kicking her left leg out toward R1
R1 is the observer/target of R2's kick rather than the kicker
R2 balances on her right leg while extending her left leg toward R1
R1 stands facing R2 and watches her action
